focus: 從模態質量與輸入歷時辨識水壩動力分析的假設界限~Identify dam-dynamics assumptions through modal mass, forcing histories and model boundaries

units.anchor: 模態質量與週期~Modal mass and period
units.title: 模態質量與週期~Modal mass and period
units.mechanism: 水壩地震反應不是把整座重量直接乘一個係數，首先要理解材料剛度、基礎與水庫如何形成振動模態。單自由度模型只代表已選定的廣義座標，其質量和剛度必須成對校準；不同模態參與程度不同，第一週期吻合也不能證明全部壩體應力分布正確。 假設線性模態質量m=50000000kg、剛度k=2000000000N/m，ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s，T=2π/ω=0.9935s。~Dam response begins with how stiffness, foundation and reservoir interactions form vibration modes rather than multiplying total weight by one coefficient. A single degree of freedom represents a chosen generalized coordinate whose mass and stiffness must be calibrated together. Matching the first period does not establish the correctness of higher modes or the complete spatial stress distribution. Assume linear modal mass50000000kg and stiffness2000000000N/m. ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s and T=2π/ω=0.9935s, for this generalized coordinate only.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設線性模態質量m=50000000kg、剛度k=2000000000N/m，ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s，T=2π/ω=0.9935s。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume linear modal mass50000000kg and stiffness2000000000N/m. ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s and T=2π/ω=0.9935s, for this generalized coordinate only.
units.verify: 在自由體圖上說明廣義座標與質量正規化，核對剛度及質量是否使用同一模態定義。將解析週期與有限元素特徵值及環境振動資料比較，保留水位和溫度條件，不只調整一個參數湊合。~Define the generalized coordinate and mass normalization and check consistent stiffness and mass conventions. Compare the analytical period with eigenvalue and ambient-vibration evidence while retaining water-level and temperature conditions rather than tuning one parameter merely to force agreement.
units.practice: 在自由體圖上說明廣義座標與質量正規化，核對剛度及質量是否使用同一模態定義。將解析週期與有限元素特徵值及環境振動資料比較，保留水位和溫度條件，不只調整一個參數湊合。~Define the generalized coordinate and mass normalization and check consistent stiffness and mass conventions. Compare the analytical period with eigenvalue and ambient-vibration evidence while retaining water-level and temperature conditions rather than tuning one parameter merely to force agreement.
units.failure: 模態質量誤用總壩重會讓週期和慣性力同時錯位，固定基礎假設也可能高估剛度。第一週期接近量測時，局部接縫、壩肩或高階反應仍可能沒有被描述。~Using total dam mass as modal mass distorts both period and inertia, while an unrealistically fixed foundation may overstate stiffness. A matching first period can still leave joints, abutments and higher-mode responses poorly represented.
units.misconception: 第一振動週期吻合即可證明整座水壩的地震應力全部正確。~Matching the first natural period proves that every earthquake stress in the dam is correct.

units.anchor: 慣性力與加速度~Inertia and acceleration definition
units.title: 慣性力與加速度~Inertia and acceleration definition
units.mechanism: 慣性力跟質量及相應的絕對加速度有關，但地表峰值、基岩輸入與結構反應不是同一數據。等效靜力只提供量級，不能代替時變相位與變形計算；三方向輸入還要保持坐標一致，避免把不同時刻峰值任意拼成實際不存在的受力狀態。 假設所選質量50000000kg瞬時絕對加速度0.20g，F=ma=98.10MN；此數值不是由地表PGA自動得到的壩體反應。~Inertia depends on mass and its corresponding absolute acceleration, but surface peak, bedrock input and structural response are different quantities. Equivalent static force gives a scale rather than temporal phase or deformation. Three-component inputs also require consistent coordinates, and unrelated peaks must not be assembled into a force state that never occurred in the actual time history. Assume selected mass50000000kg has instantaneous absolute acceleration0.20g. F=ma=98.10MN, not a dam response automatically inferred from surface PGA.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設所選質量50000000kg瞬時絕對加速度0.20g，F=ma=98.10MN；此數值不是由地表PGA自動得到的壩體反應。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume selected mass50000000kg has instantaneous absolute acceleration0.20g. F=ma=98.10MN, not a dam response automatically inferred from surface PGA.
units.verify: 分欄記錄輸入點、反應點、單位及坐標方向，確認g已乘9.81m/s²。以同時刻的加速度與支承反力檢查動力平衡，並區分絕對和相對加速度，不拿不相干峰值作平衡驗算。~Record input and response locations, units and axes separately, converting g to9.81m/s². Check dynamic balance using simultaneous accelerations and support reactions and distinguish absolute from relative acceleration instead of combining unrelated individual peak values for equilibrium.
units.practice: 分欄記錄輸入點、反應點、單位及坐標方向，確認g已乘9.81m/s²。以同時刻的加速度與支承反力檢查動力平衡，並區分絕對和相對加速度，不拿不相干峰值作平衡驗算。~Record input and response locations, units and axes separately, converting g to9.81m/s². Check dynamic balance using simultaneous accelerations and support reactions and distinguish absolute from relative acceleration instead of combining unrelated individual peak values for equilibrium.
units.failure: 把相對加速度當成絕對值可能漏掉地盤運動，三方向最大值不同時發生又會製造過大合力。反之僅用輸入PGA代表結構加速度，可能漏掉共振放大。~Treating relative acceleration as absolute omits ground motion, while asynchronous directional peaks can create an excessive resultant. Conversely, using input PGA for structural acceleration can miss amplification caused by resonant response of the selected mode.
units.misconception: 地表峰值加速度就是壩體每一點在同一時刻的絕對加速度。~Surface peak acceleration equals the simultaneous absolute acceleration at every point of the dam.

units.anchor: 阻尼係數與耗能~Damping coefficient and dissipation
units.title: 阻尼係數與耗能~Damping coefficient and dissipation
units.mechanism: 阻尼比是相對臨界阻尼的比例，實體耗能可包含材料、接縫和基礎輻射，不應任意重複加入。線性黏滯模型便於分析但不能代表所有開裂摩擦機制，且校準模態與頻率範圍必須明示；增加阻尼使數值變小不等於取得可靠設計。 假設m=50000000kg、k=2000000000N/m、ζ=0.05，c=2ζ√(km)=31622776.6N·s/m；只代表線性黏滯阻尼。~Damping ratio is relative to critical damping, while physical dissipation can include material, joints and radiation into the foundation. These effects must not be counted twice. Linear viscous damping is convenient but does not represent every cracking or friction mechanism, and calibration needs a specified modal and frequency range rather than an arbitrary value chosen to reduce response. Assume m=50000000kg,k=2000000000N/m and ζ=0.05. c=2ζ√(km)=31622776.6N·s/m, representing linear viscous damping only.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設m=50000000kg、k=2000000000N/m、ζ=0.05，c=2ζ√(km)=31622776.6N·s/m；只代表線性黏滯阻尼。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume m=50000000kg,k=2000000000N/m and ζ=0.05. c=2ζ√(km)=31622776.6N·s/m, representing linear viscous damping only.
units.verify: 列出材料阻尼、邊界吸收和接觸摩擦的實作位置，檢查同一耗能是否重複計算。以自由衰減或頻率反應資料校核，另做阻尼敏感度，保存反應改變原因而非只報最小應力。~Map material damping, absorbing boundaries and contact friction to check duplicate dissipation. Compare free-decay or frequency-response evidence and perform damping sensitivity, explaining changed response rather than reporting only the smallest calculated stress from a favorable parameter choice.
units.practice: 列出材料阻尼、邊界吸收和接觸摩擦的實作位置，檢查同一耗能是否重複計算。以自由衰減或頻率反應資料校核，另做阻尼敏感度，保存反應改變原因而非只報最小應力。~Map material damping, absorbing boundaries and contact friction to check duplicate dissipation. Compare free-decay or frequency-response evidence and perform damping sensitivity, explaining changed response rather than reporting only the smallest calculated stress from a favorable parameter choice.
units.failure: 同時採很大材料阻尼和強吸收邊界可能過度消能，掩蓋壩肩需求。把小振幅試驗阻尼直接外推到嚴重開裂狀態，也會忽略隨振幅改變的機制。~Large material damping combined with strongly absorbing boundaries can remove excessive energy and hide abutment demand. Extending small-amplitude damping into severe cracking also overlooks mechanisms that change as deformation amplitude grows during shaking.
units.misconception: 阻尼設得越大就一定越接近真實水壩的地震反應。~A larger damping value always makes the predicted dam earthquake response more realistic.

units.anchor: 諧波放大與歷時~Harmonic magnification versus history
units.title: 諧波放大與歷時~Harmonic magnification versus history
units.mechanism: 共振概念可用持續正弦力說明，但地震是有限時間且頻率不斷改變的訊號，兩者反應不能混用。線性振子的穩態放大取決於頻率比及阻尼，建立穩態需要時間；脈衝、非線性接縫和頻率漂移可能使真正峰值與簡式大不相同。 假設線性受迫穩態、頻率比r=1、ζ=0.05，R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10；非地震歷時放大保證。~Sustained sinusoidal force illustrates resonance, but earthquakes have finite duration and changing frequency content. Their responses are not interchangeable. Steady harmonic amplification depends on frequency ratio and damping and takes time to develop. Pulses, nonlinear joints and frequency shifts can make actual peaks substantially different from the simplified forced-oscillator value even when its natural period is known. Assume linear steady forced response with frequency ratio r=1 and ζ=0.05. R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10, not an earthquake amplification guarantee.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設線性受迫穩態、頻率比r=1、ζ=0.05，R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10；非地震歷時放大保證。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume linear steady forced response with frequency ratio r=1 and ζ=0.05. R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10, not an earthquake amplification guarantee.
units.verify: 畫出多個頻率比的反應曲線，標明以靜態位移為分母的定義。再輸入短脈衝與有限週期正弦比較建立時間，檢查模型仍線性時兩種結果為何不同，不把穩態峰值直接當地震需求。~Plot response over several frequency ratios and state that magnification is relative to static displacement. Compare a short pulse and finite-cycle sinusoid to show buildup time, explaining their differences within the linear model rather than directly using the steady peak as earthquake demand.
units.practice: 畫出多個頻率比的反應曲線，標明以靜態位移為分母的定義。再輸入短脈衝與有限週期正弦比較建立時間，檢查模型仍線性時兩種結果為何不同，不把穩態峰值直接當地震需求。~Plot response over several frequency ratios and state that magnification is relative to static displacement. Compare a short pulse and finite-cycle sinusoid to show buildup time, explaining their differences within the linear model rather than directly using the steady peak as earthquake demand.
units.failure: 地震短脈衝未必有時間建立穩態，直接套十倍可能高估；若忽略結構頻率變化或其他模態，也可能漏掉另一時間段的放大。單一數值無法替代完整歷時檢查。~A short pulse may not build steady resonance, making direct tenfold scaling excessive. Ignoring frequency change or additional modes can instead miss amplification later in the record, so one factor cannot replace evaluation of the full time history.
units.misconception: 共振穩態放大係數可直接乘所有地震峰值作為真實反應。~The steady resonant magnification can directly multiply every earthquake peak to give the actual response.

units.anchor: 反應譜位移換算~Spectral displacement conversion
units.title: 反應譜位移換算~Spectral displacement conversion
units.mechanism: 擬加速度反應譜與位移譜在同一線性振子和阻尼下可由角頻率換算，但擬加速度不是任意量測絕對加速度峰值。譜值忽略不同模態峰值發生時間，合成規則需另外選擇；先確認譜的定義與單位，才有資格比較位移和接縫需求。 假設同一線性振子週期T=1s、擬譜加速度Sa=0.40g，Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m；阻尼定義保持一致。~Pseudo-spectral acceleration and spectral displacement convert through angular frequency for the same linear oscillator and damping. Pseudo-acceleration is not an arbitrary measured absolute-acceleration peak. Spectra also omit the timing of different modal maxima, requiring separate combination rules. Definitions and units must therefore be checked before comparing converted displacement with joint or deformation demands. Assume the same linear oscillator has T=1s and pseudo-spectral acceleration Sa=0.40g. Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m at consistently defined damping.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設同一線性振子週期T=1s、擬譜加速度Sa=0.40g，Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m；阻尼定義保持一致。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume the same linear oscillator has T=1s and pseudo-spectral acceleration Sa=0.40g. Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m at consistently defined damping.
units.verify: 核對輸入是擬譜加速度或絕對加速度譜，將g與角頻率的轉換逐步寫出。用同一歷時振子直接求位移峰值對照，確認週期及阻尼一致，並保留多模態合成方法的另行說明。~Identify pseudo-spectral versus absolute-acceleration input and show conversion from g and period to angular frequency. Compare with direct oscillator displacement from the same record at matching period and damping, documenting the separate method used for multiple-mode combination.
units.practice: 核對輸入是擬譜加速度或絕對加速度譜，將g與角頻率的轉換逐步寫出。用同一歷時振子直接求位移峰值對照，確認週期及阻尼一致，並保留多模態合成方法的另行說明。~Identify pseudo-spectral versus absolute-acceleration input and show conversion from g and period to angular frequency. Compare with direct oscillator displacement from the same record at matching period and damping, documenting the separate method used for multiple-mode combination.
units.failure: 將Hz直接當rad/s會使位移差數十倍，不同阻尼譜混用又會改變需求。即使單模態位移正確，各模態峰值同號相加仍可能不代表任何真實時刻。~Using hertz as radians per second changes displacement by a large factor, and mixing damping definitions changes demand. Even correct individual modal displacements need not occur with equal signs at one actual instant.
units.misconception: 任何加速度峰值除以頻率平方都一定得到正確的反應譜位移。~Any acceleration peak divided by frequency squared necessarily gives the correct spectral displacement.

units.anchor: 瑞利阻尼頻帶~Rayleigh damping frequency band
units.title: 瑞利阻尼頻帶~Rayleigh damping frequency band
units.mechanism: 質量與剛度比例阻尼可在兩個指定模態匹配目標，但頻帶之外不會維持同一比例。低頻受質量項控制、高頻受剛度項控制，網格細化加入高頻模態可能造成過度衰減；應檢查整段頻率曲線，不能只驗算兩個校準點就認為全部動力都一致。 假設兩模態1與3Hz均ζ=0.05，C=αM+βK得α=0.47124s⁻¹、β=0.0039789s；在2Hz時ζ=0.04375。~Mass- and stiffness-proportional damping can match a target at two selected modes but does not maintain that ratio outside them. The mass term dominates low frequency and stiffness term high frequency, so refinement can add excessively damped modes. Examine the full curve instead of assuming that agreement at two calibration points establishes consistent damping throughout the dynamic model. Assume target damping0.05 at1 and3Hz. C=αM+βK gives α=0.47124s⁻¹,β=0.0039789s; at2Hz the damping ratio is0.04375.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設兩模態1與3Hz均ζ=0.05，C=αM+βK得α=0.47124s⁻¹、β=0.0039789s；在2Hz時ζ=0.04375。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume target damping0.05 at1 and3Hz. C=αM+βK gives α=0.47124s⁻¹,β=0.0039789s; at2Hz the damping ratio is0.04375.
units.verify: 在模型使用的最低到最高頻率畫阻尼曲線，標出兩個校準模態及中間值。網格改變後重新檢查新增高頻耗能，並確認剛度項採初始或更新剛度，避免非線性時含義悄悄改變。~Plot damping over the model’s relevant frequency range, marking calibration modes and intermediate values. Recheck high-frequency dissipation after mesh changes and identify whether the stiffness term uses initial or updated stiffness, preventing an unnoticed change of meaning in nonlinear calculations.
units.practice: 在模型使用的最低到最高頻率畫阻尼曲線，標出兩個校準模態及中間值。網格改變後重新檢查新增高頻耗能，並確認剛度項採初始或更新剛度，避免非線性時含義悄悄改變。~Plot damping over the model’s relevant frequency range, marking calibration modes and intermediate values. Recheck high-frequency dissipation after mesh changes and identify whether the stiffness term uses initial or updated stiffness, preventing an unnoticed change of meaning in nonlinear calculations.
units.failure: 高頻過度阻尼可能抹掉局部衝擊或接觸反應，低頻質量阻尼也可能對近剛體運動產生不合理耗能。只報兩點匹配，無法看出頻帶外的數值偏差。~Excessive high-frequency damping erases local impact or contact response, while low-frequency mass damping may dissipate near-rigid movement unrealistically. Reporting only two fitted points hides numerical behavior outside the calibration band of the model.
units.misconception: 瑞利阻尼只要在兩個頻率匹配就會在所有頻率保持同樣阻尼比。~Rayleigh damping fitted at two frequencies has the same damping ratio at every frequency.

units.anchor: 附加水質量與週期~Added water mass and period
units.title: 附加水質量與週期~Added water mass and period
units.mechanism: 水庫動壓可能與壩體運動耦合，簡化附加質量僅在已指定形狀與頻率條件下代表某種等效作用。不能把整個水庫重量直接加到壩上，亦不能忽略可壓縮性、邊界吸收或水位改變；本單元固定剛度，只檢查一個假設附加量如何改變週期。 假設原模態m=50000000kg、附加水質量20000000kg、k=2000000000N/m，T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s。~Reservoir pressure can couple with dam movement, while an added-mass approximation represents an equivalent effect only under stated geometry and frequency conditions. The entire reservoir mass cannot be attached to the dam, nor can compressibility, absorption and water-level change always be ignored. This unit holds stiffness fixed to isolate the period effect of one assumed modal addition. Assume modal mass50000000kg,added water mass20000000kg and unchanged stiffness2000000000N/m. T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s for this assumed approximation.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設原模態m=50000000kg、附加水質量20000000kg、k=2000000000N/m，T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume modal mass50000000kg,added water mass20000000kg and unchanged stiffness2000000000N/m. T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s for this assumed approximation.
units.verify: 明列附加質量的推導範圍與所代表模態，與流固耦合模型在多個水位下比較。檢查水庫邊界是否過近造成反射，保存原質量和附加量分項，不把週期延長全歸因於材料變軟。~State the added-mass derivation and represented mode and compare coupled calculations at several levels. Check artificial reflection from nearby reservoir boundaries, retaining structural and water contributions separately rather than attributing every period increase to softened dam material.
units.practice: 明列附加質量的推導範圍與所代表模態，與流固耦合模型在多個水位下比較。檢查水庫邊界是否過近造成反射，保存原質量和附加量分項，不把週期延長全歸因於材料變軟。~State the added-mass derivation and represented mode and compare coupled calculations at several levels. Check artificial reflection from nearby reservoir boundaries, retaining structural and water contributions separately rather than attributing every period increase to softened dam material.
units.failure: 直接加整個水庫質量會嚴重扭曲週期，人工反射又可能假造動壓峰值。僅因空庫與滿庫週期不同就判定結構劣化，會把正常流固互制當成損傷。~Attaching the entire reservoir mass grossly distorts period, and artificial reflections create spurious pressure peaks. Declaring deterioration solely from empty- versus full-reservoir period differences mistakes normal fluid-structure interaction for structural damage.
units.misconception: 水庫對水壩動力的作用就是把全部庫水重量加到壩體質量。~Reservoir interaction simply adds the mass of all stored water to the dam.

units.anchor: 同步位移與接縫~Synchronized displacement and joints
units.title: 同步位移與接縫~Synchronized displacement and joints
units.mechanism: 接縫張開由相鄰部位同一時刻的相對位移決定，而不是兩個獨立最大值相減或平方和。坐標方向和局部法向需先定義，剛體平移應在相減時消除；縫面接觸、止水材料與剪切交互作用則需另建模型，位移量本身不代表水密性。 假設同時刻沿接縫法向位移u1=12mm、u2=−8mm，相對張開u1−u2=20mm；不是各自峰值的非同步組合。~Joint opening comes from simultaneous relative displacement, not subtraction or quadrature of unrelated extrema. Coordinate direction and local normal must be defined so common rigid translation cancels. Contact, waterstop response and combined shear require additional models; a displacement difference alone does not establish watertightness or allowable joint performance during an earthquake. Assume simultaneous normal displacements u1=12mm and u2=−8mm. Relative opening is20mm, rather than a combination of nonconcurrent individual maxima.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設同時刻沿接縫法向位移u1=12mm、u2=−8mm，相對張開u1−u2=20mm；不是各自峰值的非同步組合。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume simultaneous normal displacements u1=12mm and u2=−8mm. Relative opening is20mm, rather than a combination of nonconcurrent individual maxima.
units.verify: 先把兩側位移轉到同一局部法向與時鐘，再逐時刻求差並找峰值。另列剪切滑移、接觸壓和止水變形，檢查剛體平移能否抵銷，保留真正控制時刻供受力與漏水判讀。~Transform both records to one local normal and synchronized clock, then difference each time step before locating the peak. Record shear, contact pressure and waterstop deformation separately, checking cancellation of rigid translation and retaining the actual controlling instant for interpretation.
units.practice: 先把兩側位移轉到同一局部法向與時鐘，再逐時刻求差並找峰值。另列剪切滑移、接觸壓和止水變形，檢查剛體平移能否抵銷，保留真正控制時刻供受力與漏水判讀。~Transform both records to one local normal and synchronized clock, then difference each time step before locating the peak. Record shear, contact pressure and waterstop deformation separately, checking cancellation of rigid translation and retaining the actual controlling instant for interpretation.
units.failure: 時鐘偏移會把原本同步移動變成假張開，法向反轉又可能讓共同平移加倍。只取單側峰值會錯過兩側反向運動，低估止水和接觸介面的真正需求。~Clock offsets make common movement appear as opening, and reversed normals can double rigid translation. A one-sided peak can miss opposing movements and understate the actual demand on waterstops and contact interfaces between neighboring blocks.
units.misconception: 接縫最大張開永遠等於兩側各自最大位移的平方和平方根。~Maximum joint opening always equals the root-sum-square of each side's individual peak displacement.

units.anchor: 時間步與高頻解析~Timestep and high-frequency resolution
units.title: 時間步與高頻解析~Timestep and high-frequency resolution
units.mechanism: 動力積分步長要解析關心的短週期，但每週期點數只是起點，不是收斂證明。輸入記錄取樣、內插方法、積分演算法和非線性接觸都可能施加更嚴限制；縮小步長後應比較峰值、相位及能量，而不是只確認程式沒有發散或報錯。 假設最短關注週期0.20s、積分步長0.005s，點數T/Δt=40；不能由此保證輸入頻寬或接觸反應已解析。~A dynamic timestep must resolve relevant short periods, but points per cycle are only an initial check, not proof of convergence. Input sampling, interpolation, integration algorithm and nonlinear contact may impose stricter limits. Refinement should compare peaks, phase and energy rather than merely confirming that software completes without numerical divergence or reported errors. Assume the shortest relevant period0.20s and timestep0.005s. T/Δt=40points per cycle, without guaranteeing input bandwidth or resolved contact response.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設最短關注週期0.20s、積分步長0.005s，點數T/Δt=40；不能由此保證輸入頻寬或接觸反應已解析。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume the shortest relevant period0.20s and timestep0.005s. T/Δt=40points per cycle, without guaranteeing input bandwidth or resolved contact response.
units.verify: 使用相同物理模型分別減半步長，對照位移峰值、加速度與能量殘差，另檢查原始輸入取樣率。不要以內插創造原記錄沒有的高頻證據，並把未收斂局部反應獨立標示。~Halve the timestep with unchanged physics and compare displacement peaks, acceleration and energy residuals while checking original input sampling. Interpolation cannot create missing high-frequency evidence; flag local responses that remain unconverged rather than hiding them in global averages.
units.practice: 使用相同物理模型分別減半步長，對照位移峰值、加速度與能量殘差，另檢查原始輸入取樣率。不要以內插創造原記錄沒有的高頻證據，並把未收斂局部反應獨立標示。~Halve the timestep with unchanged physics and compare displacement peaks, acceleration and energy residuals while checking original input sampling. Interpolation cannot create missing high-frequency evidence; flag local responses that remain unconverged rather than hiding them in global averages.
units.failure: 程式穩定仍可能有顯著相位誤差，粗步長也會漏掉短促接觸力。把稀疏輸入內插成密集資料看似解析度提高，實際卻沒有補回缺失的地震頻率內容。~A stable computation can retain serious phase error and miss brief contact forces. Interpolating sparse input into many samples looks more resolved but does not restore earthquake frequencies absent from the original measured record.
units.misconception: 動力程式成功跑完且每週期有足夠點數就不必再查收斂。~A completed dynamic run with many points per period never needs a convergence assessment.

units.anchor: 土壩孔壓與有效應力~Embankment pore pressure and effective stress
units.title: 土壩孔壓與有效應力~Embankment pore pressure and effective stress
units.mechanism: 土石壩可能發生循環孔壓增加及強度改變，這與混凝土線彈性振子是不同機制。有效應力下降需以相同應力路徑和時間的資料計算，孔壓比接近某值也不能單獨宣告整座壩已液化；殘餘強度、震後排水與永久變形仍需專門材料和穩定分析。 假設初有效垂直應力100kPa、總應力固定而超額孔壓增60kPa，ru=0.60，剩餘有效應力40kPa；非液化整體判定。~Embankments can develop cyclic pore pressure and altered strength, mechanisms distinct from a linear concrete oscillator. Effective-stress reduction needs matching stress paths and times. A pore-pressure ratio alone cannot declare the entire dam liquefied; residual strength, post-earthquake drainage and permanent deformation still require appropriate material testing and stability analysis rather than transfer of concrete-dam assumptions. Assume initial effective vertical stress100kPa and excess pore-pressure rise60kPa at fixed total stress. ru=0.60 and remaining effective stress40kPa, not a global liquefaction verdict.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設初有效垂直應力100kPa、總應力固定而超額孔壓增60kPa，ru=0.60，剩餘有效應力40kPa；非液化整體判定。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume initial effective vertical stress100kPa and excess pore-pressure rise60kPa at fixed total stress. ru=0.60 and remaining effective stress40kPa, not a global liquefaction verdict.
units.verify: 將孔壓與總應力歷時同步，核對初始有效應力和超額孔壓的基準。比較不同土層的循環試驗與震後強度，記錄局部高孔壓位置和排水路徑，避免把單點比值推廣到所有壩體材料。~Synchronize pore-pressure and total-stress histories, checking initial effective stress and the excess-pressure reference. Compare layer-specific cyclic tests and post-shaking strength, mapping local high pressures and drainage routes without extending one point ratio to every material in the dam.
units.practice: 將孔壓與總應力歷時同步，核對初始有效應力和超額孔壓的基準。比較不同土層的循環試驗與震後強度，記錄局部高孔壓位置和排水路徑，避免把單點比值推廣到所有壩體材料。~Synchronize pore-pressure and total-stress histories, checking initial effective stress and the excess-pressure reference. Compare layer-specific cyclic tests and post-shaking strength, mapping local high pressures and drainage routes without extending one point ratio to every material in the dam.
units.failure: 把總孔壓誤當超額孔壓會高估累積，忽略總應力變動則可能誤判有效應力。局部弱層即使不控制平均值，也可能形成永久變形路徑，不能只看整壩平均反應。~Using total pressure instead of excess pressure overstates accumulation, while omitted total-stress variation misstates effective stress. A local weak layer can govern permanent deformation despite a modest average ratio across the wider dam body.
units.misconception: 土石壩的孔壓變化可直接用混凝土線彈性振子的阻尼比完全代表。~Embankment pore-pressure change is fully represented by the damping ratio of a linear concrete oscillator.

title: 水壩地震動力分析~Seismic dynamic analysis of dams
summary: 本課把混凝土水壩的線性模態示意與土石壩孔壓機制分開，從質量、剛度、阻尼及地震輸入逐步走向水庫互制、接縫與數值收斂。十個單元均有原創計算與明確邊界，要求學徒追蹤同時刻、同座標和相同物理定義，不以單一週期或峰值吻合宣告整壩耐震合格。~The course separates linear concrete-dam modal illustrations from embankment pore-pressure mechanisms. It moves through mass, stiffness, damping and forcing to reservoir interaction, joints and numerical convergence. Ten original calculations require consistent time, coordinates and physical definitions; matching one period or peak never establishes complete seismic adequacy.
history: 水壩耐震方法隨結構型式及材料機制而分化，不能以一套線性振子概括所有壩。胡佛壩官方歷史記錄一九三五年主壩混凝土澆置完成，西斯克壩則在一九六三至一九六七年建成分區土石結構，兩者在此只作材料與幾何比較。工兵團二〇〇三年手冊整理混凝土水工結構線彈性歷時分析，墾務局二〇一五年土石壩耐震章節另處理相關土壤行為。課程以可追溯出版紀錄說明方法範圍，不宣稱原創質量、剛度或孔壓值曾在這些工程量得，也不把古老工程完成年份視為現行耐震驗證。~Seismic methods differ with structural form and material mechanism; one linear oscillator cannot describe every dam. Hoover’s official history records completion of main-dam concrete in1935, while Sisk was built as a zoned embankment during1963–1967. They are used only for material and geometry comparison. The2003 USACE manual addresses linear-elastic time histories for concrete hydraulic structures, while Reclamation’s2015 embankment chapter addresses relevant soil behavior. Publication history defines scope, without presenting synthetic masses, stiffnesses or pore pressures as measurements at these landmarks or treating historical completion as current seismic verification.
example: 原創敏感度：選定模態質量50000000kg與線性剛度2000000000N/m，週期T=2π√(m/k)=0.9935s。只把剛度增加10%至2200000000N/m、質量不變，週期變成0.9472s，約減少4.65%，不是減少10%。這項計算僅隔離剛度影響，沒有證明實際壩體可用補強達到此值；基礎、水庫、接縫與阻尼也可能同時改變。學徒需先寫出廣義座標和校準方法，再比較週期、模態形狀與應力位置是否一起合理。即使週期縮短，地震需求可能因輸入譜形改變而升高或降低，不能直接推論風險同步下降。~Original sensitivity: selected modal mass50000000kg and stiffness2000000000N/m give T=2π√(m/k)=0.9935s. Increase only stiffness by10% to2200000000N/m at unchanged mass; period becomes0.9472s, about4.65% shorter rather than10%. This isolates stiffness and does not establish that a real retrofit can achieve the assumed change. Foundation, reservoir, joints and damping may also vary. Define the generalized coordinate and calibration evidence before comparing period, mode shape and stress location together. Even a shorter period can increase or decrease seismic demand depending on the forcing spectrum; it cannot directly establish a corresponding reduction in risk.
facts: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設線性模態質量m=50000000kg、剛度k=2000000000N/m，ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s，T=2π/ω=0.9935s。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume linear modal mass50000000kg and stiffness2000000000N/m. ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s and T=2π/ω=0.9935s, for this generalized coordinate only.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設所選質量50000000kg瞬時絕對加速度0.20g，F=ma=98.10MN；此數值不是由地表PGA自動得到的壩體反應。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume selected mass50000000kg has instantaneous absolute acceleration0.20g. F=ma=98.10MN, not a dam response automatically inferred from surface PGA.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設m=50000000kg、k=2000000000N/m、ζ=0.05，c=2ζ√(km)=31622776.6N·s/m；只代表線性黏滯阻尼。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume m=50000000kg,k=2000000000N/m and ζ=0.05. c=2ζ√(km)=31622776.6N·s/m, representing linear viscous damping only.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設線性受迫穩態、頻率比r=1、ζ=0.05，R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10；非地震歷時放大保證。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume linear steady forced response with frequency ratio r=1 and ζ=0.05. R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10, not an earthquake amplification guarantee.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設同一線性振子週期T=1s、擬譜加速度Sa=0.40g，Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m；阻尼定義保持一致。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume the same linear oscillator has T=1s and pseudo-spectral acceleration Sa=0.40g. Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m at consistently defined damping.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設兩模態1與3Hz均ζ=0.05，C=αM+βK得α=0.47124s⁻¹、β=0.0039789s；在2Hz時ζ=0.04375。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume target damping0.05 at1 and3Hz. C=αM+βK gives α=0.47124s⁻¹,β=0.0039789s; at2Hz the damping ratio is0.04375.
